table.name: TLGNU_ROLE
table.description: A user role bundles a set of functions (tlgnu_function). Assigning a role to a user grants the user access to the functions contained in the role. Although there is an M:N relation between roles and functions, the set of functions contained in roles should be kept disjoint of each other if possible. Users can be granted several roles. Granting a role is restricted to users who posess the right (tlgnu_func) specified by GRANTABLE_BY_FUNC_ID.

column.name: ROLE_NAME
column.description: The Name of the Role as it appears in the User Administration.

column.name: GRANTABLE_BY_FUNC_ID
column.description: FK tlgnu_func. The function (right) that a user with user-admin rights needs to have in order to grant/assign this role to another user. With this mechanism we distinguish 'User Admin' from 'User Admin Lite'.
